$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F04 three-quarter (A2) from the wearer's right. The old wordmark printed in light ink on the near metal temple comes off, rebuilt along the temple. The GCD sits on the right end-piece, placed from the 1:1 drawing: four of the end-piece's corners (the wire's top and bottom where it joins, the two front corners) in the side view's millimetres and in the picture (tools/photo/temple_gcd.py), the end-piece and the front's side read as one flat triangle, from the wire to the front's outer corners, and the GCD is centered on that triangle (its centroid, 11.5 mm from the front and 10.6 mm down in the side view; founder, Oct 20 2026), along the drawing's horizontal.
